purpose: Reference capabilities for mapping existing Website-owned digital-commerce implementations; never a storage schema or business-rule authority.

runtimeReference.note: Read publish-contract.md and copy/run the publish-chain assets only when the source registry declares the products publish transition (from states + to) and the bound product entity exposes both slug and cover-image publish surfaces. A slug or image field alone must not trigger the suite or cause publishing to be invented. SKU-level checks run only when the registry declares SKU support; a product-only source must not invent SKU records. Seed-token checks run only when the source has referenced tokens. The unpublish-republish loop runs only when the registry declares an unpublish transition back to a legal publish from-state. If an asset is missing, implement the same narrow in-process surface inline and report the degradation.
